title: Roshini @ Thresiamma vs Rajesh Joseph @ Chacko on 14 June, 2010

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM

 PRESENT:

 THE HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE K.T.SANKARAN
 &
 THE HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE M.L.JOSEPH FRANCIS

 WEDNESDAY, THE 16TH DAY OF JANUARY 2013/26TH POUSHA 1934

 Mat.Appeal.No. 751 of 2010

 AGAINST THE JUDGMENT IN OP.725/2009 DATED 14-06-2010
 OF THE FAMILY COURT, KOTTAYAM AT ETTUMANOOR.


APPELLANT: RESPONDENT:


 ROSHINI @ THRESIAMMA, AGED 29 YEARS,
 D/O. P.D.APREM,PAMPOORICKAL HOUSE,
 KAVUMBHAGAM P.O., CHERUVALLY VILLAGE,
 KANJIRAPPALLY TALUK
 KOTTAYAM DISTRICT.

 BY ADVS.SRI.TPM.IBRAHIM KHAN (SR.)
 SMT.P.SHYNI

RESPONDENT: PETITIONER:

 RAJESH JOSEPH @ CHACKO, AGED 38 YEARS,
 S/O. A.V.JOSEPH,AKKATTU PUTHENPURACKAL HOUSE
 KARIKKATTOOR P.O.,KANJIRAPPALLY TALUK
 KOTTAYAM DISTRICT,PIN-686 544.

 BY ADV. SRI.P.JACOB VARGHESE (SR.)
 BY ADV. SRI.VIVEK VARGHESE P.J.



 THIS MATRIMONIAL APPEAL HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD ON
16.01.2013, ALONGWITH MAT. APPEAL NOS.761 AND 762 OF 2010 AND O.P.(FC)
NO.2198 OF 2012, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

 I.A.NO.2352/2010 IN M.A.NO.751/2010

 DISMISSED

 SD/- K.T.SANKARAN, JUDGE

 16/01/2013 SD/- M.L.JOSEPH FRANCIS, JUDGE



 //TRUE COPY//



AHZ/



 K.T.SANKARAN &
 M.L.JOSEPH FRANCIS, JJ.
 ----------------------------------------------------
 Mat. Appeal Nos.751, 761 & 762 of 2010
 and
 O.P.(F.C.) No.2198 OF 2012
 ----------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 16th day of January, 2013


 JUDGMENT
K.T.Sankaran, J.

In Mat. Appeal Nos.751 of 2010 and 762 of 2010, the

appellant is Roshni @ Thresiamma, the wife of the respondent

Rajesh Joseph @ Chacko. In Mat. Appeal No.761 of 2010, the

appellants are Rajesh Joseph @ Chacko and his parents and the

respondent is Roshni @ Thresiamma. In O.P.(F.C.) No.2198 of

2012, Roshni @ Thresiamma is the petitioner and Rajesh Joseph @

Chacko is the respondent.

2. Roshni and Rajesh Joseph are hereinafter referred to as

wife and husband. The wife filed O.P.No.395 of 2009 on the file of

the Family Court, Kottayam at Ettumanoor, against the husband and

his parents for a decree for return of Rupees Twenty lakhs allegedly

paid at the time of marriage. As per the common judgment dated

Mat. Appeal Nos.751, 761 & 762/2010
and O.P. (F.C.) No.2198 OF 2012.

14.6.2010, the Family Court granted a decree in favour of the wife

for a sum of Rupees Sixteen lakhs together with interest. The

husband filed Mat. Appeal No.761 of 2010 challenging the judgment

and decree in O.P.No.395 of 2009.

3. The husband filed O.P.No.725 of 2009 against the wife

before the Family Court, Kottayam at Ettumanoor, for restitution of

conjugal rights. The wife filed O.P.No.561 of 2009 for divorce. The

Family Court, as per the common judgment dated 14.6.2010,

allowed O.P.No.725 of 2009 filed by the husband and dismissed

O.P.No.561 of 2009 filed by the wife. Mat. Appeal No.751 of 2010 is

filed by the wife challenging the judgment and decree in O.P.No.725

of 2009. Mat. Appeal No.762 of 2010 is filed by the wife challenging

the judgment and decree in O.P.No.561 of 2009. O.P.No.567 of

2012 on the file of the Family Court, Kottayam was filed by the

husband against the wife for appointing the husband as the guardian

of the minor child and for custody of the minor child for the periods

specified in the Original Petition. Other ancillary reliefs were also

claimed in O.P.No.567 of 2012. An interim order dated 23.6.2012 in

I.A.No.738 of 2012 was passed in O.P.No.567 of 2012, by which, the

Mat. Appeal Nos.751, 761 & 762/2010
and O.P. (F.C.) No.2198 OF 2012.

husband was provided interim custody of the minor child Alwin

during alternate week ends. That order is challenged by the wife in

O.P.(F.C.) No.2198 of 2012.

4. The parties settled all their disputes and differences and a

compromise petition dated 16.1.2013 is filed in Mat. Appeal No.761

of 2010. The terms of the compromise are the following:

"1. Shri. Rajesh Joseph, the 1st respondent

 husband agree to pay an amount of Rs.10,00,000/-

 (Rupees ten lakhs only) to Smt.Roshni Aprem, the

 petitioner-wife by way of compensation, as against the

 decree for Rs.16 lakhs ordered by the Family Court in

 O.P.No.395/2009, who in turn agree that she will receive

 the said amount in full and final settlement of all the

 claims for compensation claimed by her in the Family

 Court in O.P.No.395 of 2009.

2. The petitioner agree that she has already

 received an amount of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees two lakhs

 only) out of the said Rs.Ten Lakhs so agreed to. The 1st

 respondent agree and undertake to pay the balance

 amount of Rs.8,00,000/- (Rs. Eight Lakhs only) by

 Demand Draft drawn in favour of the wife on 16.1.2013

Mat. Appeal Nos.751, 761 & 762/2010
and O.P. (F.C.) No.2198 OF 2012.

and the petitioner has received Rs.8,00,000/- (Rs.Eight

 Lakhs only) in full and final settlement of all the arrears

 payable in the above account. The 2nd respondent is

 paying this amount by Demand Draft No.267601

 dt.16/1/2013 for Rs.8,00,000/- (Rupees eight lakhs only)

 drawn on Dhanlexmi Bank Ltd., Bar Council Branch,

 which the petitioner has accepted.

3. The 1st respondent agrees that he would

 continue to pay the monthly agreed payment of

 Rs.2500/- (Rupees two thousand five hundred only) to

 the child by Demand Draft to the petitioner towards the

 claim for the maintenance of the minor child, as awarded

 by the Family Court, in the maintenance case. This

 payment shall be made till the minor child attains the

 age of majority or as altered by the Family Court later.

4. The petitioner-wife agrees that she will cause

 to produce the minor child Alwin Rajesh either by herself

 or through her mother Rosamma for the custody of the

 husband Rajesh Joseph (1st respondent) between 9

 a.m. and 5 p.m., on every first and third Saturdays of the

 month before the Head Ministerial Officer of Family

 Court, Kottayam at Ettumanoor. If any of the Saturdays

 fall on a holiday the child shall be produced on the next

 working day of the Family Court.

Mat. Appeal Nos.751, 761 & 762/2010
and O.P. (F.C.) No.2198 OF 2012.

5. The 1st respondent agree that an amount of

 Rs.700/- (Rupees seven hundred only) will be paid by

 him at the time of the production of the child to the

 person who bring the child to the Court as Traveling

 expenses.

6. The respondent further agree that he will return

 the child between 4.30 and 5.00 p.m. on the above said

 Saturdays at the residence of the wife. It is further

 agreed that this arrangement of right of visitation and

 custody of the child will be subject to the further orders

 or modifications by the Family Court, Ettumanoor after

 hearing both the parties for the custody of the child and

 in the welfare of the child.

7. In order to undertake the prompt production of

 the child as agreed that, the mother of the petitioner

 Smt.Rosamma is also joining as a party in this

 settlement.

8. The petitioner agrees that she has no objection

 in the Family Court, Ettumanoor vacating all the interim

 orders of attachment against the husband and his

 properties and further agrees that she has no objection

 in the Family Court, Ettumanoor returning all the security

 documents to the respondents.

9. The petitioner and the respondent are today

 filing a Joint Petition under section 10(A) of the Indian

 Divorce Act before this Hon'ble Court in the Mat. Appeal

 762/2010 pending before this Hon'ble Court and pray

 that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to pass

 appropriate orders allowing the joint petition declaring

 the marriage between the petitioner and the 1st

 respondent solemnized on 14/1/2007 at St.James

 Church, Karikattoor, Manimala.

10. It is further agreed that an amount of

 Rs.1,58,400/- (Rupees one lakh and fifty eight thousand

 four hundred only) deposited by the 1st respondent on

 18/12/2010 by Receipt No.32, in E.P.No.136/2010 in

 Family Court, Ettumanoor as directed by this Hon'ble

 Court in IA.No.2387/2010 in Mat.Appeal No.761/2010,

 can be withdrawn by him and the petitioner has no claim

 or objection over the said amount being refunded to the

 1st respondent on the basis of the settlement.

11. This Settlement is applicable to all the other

 connected cases, Mat. Appeal Nos.751/2010, 762/2010

 and OP(FC) No.2198/2012 before this Hon'ble Court."

The husband and wife together have filed a joint petition for

divorce under Section 10(A) of the Divorce Act as well in Mat.

Appeal No.762 of 2010. In view of the compromise between the

parties, the Matrimonial Appeals and the Original Petition (F.C.) are

disposed of in terms of the compromise. Accordingly:

a) O.P.No.567 of 2012 is disposed of in terms of the

 compromise.

b) The decree in O.P.No.395 of 2009 is fully satisfied and full

 satisfaction of the decree is recorded.
c) The decree in O.P.No.725 of 2009 is set aside.

d) O.P.No.561 of 2009 is disposed of in terms of the compromise

 and I.A.No.153 of 2013 filed under Section 10(A) of the

 Divorce Act will be dealt with separately.

(K.T.SANKARAN)
 Judge




 (M.L.JOSEPH FRANCIS)
 Judge
ahz/
